coverage.notes: Covers the email signup request acceptance route only. Excludes mailbox access, token verification completion, Google auth, and post-signup login.

preconditions: The local frontend and backend E2E servers are reachable.
The run starts in an anonymous state with no active session.
A unique signup email address can be generated for the current run.
The E2E backend mailer accepts signup mail dispatch without requiring a real inbox.
assertions: The register form is visible at /auth/register.
A valid email-based signup request can be submitted successfully.
The account registration success message is displayed.
The confirmation-email notice is displayed after submission.
notes: Generates a unique timestamp-based email address per run to keep the signup acceptance check repeatable in the local E2E environment.
